observations: Black game console with the PlayStation logo on the front.
One black DualShock 4 controller is placed in front of the console.
The console is sitting on a dark, speckled countertop.
A watermark 'LIBERTY ELECTRONIC' is visible across the center of the image.
The background consists of green artificial foliage and a blue wall.

claims.evidence: The storage capacity is not visible on the front of the console in photo 0.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The internal storage may be a 500GB model instead of 1TB.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the storage capacity.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate the menu.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the System Information screen showing the storage capacity.
Video of the console powering on and navigating the home menu.
Video of the controller being used to navigate the menu.
Photo of the rear ports to check for damage.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Sony PlayStation 4 Pro from photo 0. It can be priced at its worst case (non-working) until proof of functionality and storage capacity is provided.
